name: EuBiologics Co., Ltd.
summary: EuBiologics Co., Ltd., a biopharmaceutical company, focuses on developing vaccines against global pandemic and bacterial vaccines primarily in South Korea. It offers inactivated oral cholera vaccine under the Euvichol, Euvichol-Plus, and Euvichol-S names; and EuCorVac-19, a recombinant protein vaccine. The company also provides EcML that is used as a vaccine adjuvant, directly activating antigen presenting cell expressing TLR 4 agonist, stimulating the production of cytokines and co-stimulatory molecules.
